rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: Wooting 80HE+ and Akko's IFA 2026 magnetic lineup keep hall-effect/rapid-trigger the dominant switch category, with attention holding steady near its ceiling.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: No fresh controversy this week; reviewers continue citing the 2024 retooling favorably against Gateron rivals, nudging sentiment further out of negative territory.

rows.name: Gateron Magnetic Jade Emerald
rows.note: Fresh reviews and expanded vendor stock push continued momentum for this adjustable-actuation tactile Hall Effect switch.

rows.name: Durock T1
rows.note: Reviews remain consistently positive on smoothness and value versus Holy Panda; no new catalyst this week, sentiment holds steady.

rows.name: TMR (Tunnel Magnetoresistance) switches
rows.note: Keychron's Q16 HE 8K ceramic-TMR launch and Cherry XTRFY's K5 Pro push TMR further into mainstream adoption, positioning it as Hall Effect's successor.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: Backorders continue at several vendors while others restock, keeping Oil King in active hunt conversations this week.

rows.name: GMK CYL Orange Alert
rows.note: Sits deep into its order window with no fresh vendor push this week; estimated February 2027 shipping keeps buyer attention in a holding pattern.

rows.name: DCS Dolch / Molch
rows.note: DCS Dolch's group buy closed 2026-07-01 with shipping estimated October 2026; the design remains a steady post-buy discussion topic with no fresh catalyst this week.

rows.name: GMK CYL OG Extensions
rows.note: Continues a steady decline in mentions with no new accent-pack or restock news this week.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: Keychron x Yusha Kobo's 'Valkey Orb' split-trackball board announcement reinforces near-ceiling split/ergo interest.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: Continues recovering from its trough as 2026 buyer guides cite Alice picks favorably, though sentiment remains net-negative.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: Cited this week as the largest compact-layout segment by share, reinforcing its position as the default hybrid work-and-gaming form factor.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: Opened preorders for the Prologue 98% board on 2026-09-17, debuting a new Crown mounting system, extending the vendor's hot streak after Sonnet R2's group buy.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: Touchstone preorder's limited-time pricing deadline on 2026-09-28 is driving renewed urgency and traffic this week.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: Stable week with ongoing UK-market keycap and case distribution; no major new announcement.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: The Valkey Orb split-trackball collab and V6 Ultra Hybrid TMR Kickstarter keep the brand at peak attention, holding at its ceiling score.

rows.name: Cherry (MX + XTRFY)
rows.note: XTRFY's TMR-equipped K5 Pro Compact turns sentiment positive for the first time in eight weeks.

rows.name: Topre / HHKB
rows.note: A 30th Anniversary HHKB model is now in stock alongside a Back to School discount, sustaining renewed interest in electrocapacitive boards.

rows.name: Wooting
rows.note: 80HE+ preorders opened 2026-09-17 with a split spacebar and new knob accessory, alongside a Wootility 5.0 software release.
